title: Iigadi Eziphelayo Zobutyebi
intro: Kwilizwe elisikelelwe ngentabalala yentabalala, uluntu lwachuma, luphila phakathi kwemiqondiso yobubele bukaThixo. Impumelelo yabo yayibubungqina bobubele beNkosi yabo, isipho esenzelwe ukukhuthaza umbulelo nokuthobela. Nangona kunjalo, nangona kwakukho imiqondiso ecacileyo yeentsikelelo zabo, kwafika inguqu, eyayibachasa uxabiso lwabo ngomthombo wobutyebi babo obukhulu kunye nentuthuzelo.
clues: Sasikelelwe ngeegadi ezimbini, enye ingasekunene nenye ingasekhohlo, zizele yimveliso.
Sayalelwa ukuba sitye kwizibonelelo zeNkosi yethu size simbulele ngelizwe elihle neNkosi exolelayo.
Sakhula sizikhukhumeza saza sayishiya indlela yokubulela, siqhayisa ngobutyebi namandla ethu.
Sasifuna ukuba iNkosi yethu yonyuse umgama phakathi kohambo lwethu, sibonakalisa ukungakuthandi ukulula awayekunikezile.
Salumkiswa ngumthunywa, kodwa sawugatya umyalezo saza saqhubeka nokungathobeli kwethu.
Idama lethu elikhulu, elalisigcinele impumelelo, ekugqibeleni laqhekeka, nto leyo eyakhokelela kwizikhukula ezinkulu.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Sasichithachithekile kwaye umhlaba wethu waba yintlango
outcome.answer: Sasichithachithekile kwaye umhlaba wethu waba yintlango

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
